name: Shifting Blood
body:
School: transmutation; Level: alchemist 1, cleric/oracle 2, druid 3, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: touch

Target: creature touched
Duration: 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance: yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The subject of this spell gains the shapechanger subtype, allowing it to assume its natural form as a standard action. This does not prevent spells or effects from affecting the subject; it simply allows the subject to revert to its natural form it if wishes without suffering the normal disorientation of shapeshifting magic. This does not protect the subject from other transformation effects, such as lycanthropy. If the subject already has the ability to change forms, for the duration of this spell they can shift form as a swift action.
